01 — About Me

Who I Am

Hey, I'm Touheed Shah — a Computer Science student from Islamabad, Pakistan with a burning focus on Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Robotics, while actively growing as a Full Stack Web Developer.

I chose this path because I believe the most extraordinary problems of our time will be solved through intelligent systems — and I want to be one of the people building those solutions.

I'm currently in my 2nd year of BSCS, but I'm not waiting to graduate to start. I'm learning, building, and pushing every day toward my goal — landing a role at a world-class tech company where I can create real impact at scale.

"Islamabad built my roots. Technology is building my future."

ProactiveGuard — Predictive Heat-Stroke Risk Engine

A per-worker forecasting system that predicts heat-stroke risk 15–30 minutes before it happens — combining a physics-based digital twin, an XGBoost classifier, and SHAP explainability. 0.994 weighted F1 on a physics-simulated multi-site dataset.
